title: Madeira or the Azores: Which Is Better for Whales and Boat Trips?
description: The Azores win for big whales, with sperm whales all year and blue whales in spring. Madeira is warmer, closer, and suits coastal boat trips with a swim stop.
heroAlt: The tail of a sperm whale rising above calm blue sea, with Madeira's mountains faint behind
keywords: best time for whales in the Azores

images.prompt: Telephoto wildlife photograph taken from a boat at a respectful distance, mid-morning on a calm day far off Madeira's south coast: the broad dark tail fluke of a sperm whale rising straight out of smooth deep blue water as it dives, water streaming from its edges. Far behind, the mountains of Madeira rise faint and blue in light haze. No boat in frame, no people, natural light, true colours, no text, no logos.
images.alt: The tail of a sperm whale rising above calm blue sea, with Madeira's mountains faint behind
